Hubbell guidance raise OR cut 2026 third quarter results

findings.claim: Q3 2026（10/27）Hubbell 把 FY2026 調整後 EPS 指引由 20.25–20.55 上調至 20.40–20.60；中點僅升約 $0.10，而當季 beat $0.16，新中點與市場共識大致相當，股價當日跌約 6%
findings.source: TIKR: Hubbell Sinks 6% Despite Q3 Beat as Raised Outlook Only Matches Wall Street
findings.excerpt: Hubbell beat the quarter by $0.16 a share but raised its full-year midpoint by just $0.10.

findings.claim: Q3 公司上調全年展望，主因 Electrical Solutions 成長（資料中心）；NSI 併購整合優於原預期
findings.excerpt: We are raising our full year 2026 outlook, primarily driven by stronger anticipated Electrical Solutions growth.

findings.source: MarketBeat / aggregator via search: Hubbell updates FY2026 earnings guidance
findings.excerpt: The company provided EPS guidance of 20.250-20.550 for the period, compared to the consensus estimate of 19.980.

findings.claim: Chartmill 顯示 FY2026 共識 EPS 20.88（19 位分析師，2026-10-17），近三個月 FY EPS 預估上修約 4%
findings.excerpt: Latest recorded estimate: 20.88 USD · Oct 17, 2026 · 19 analysts

findings.claim: 目標價分布：Benzinga 14 位分析師均值 $504、高 $600、低 $325；另 Benzinga 價格頁 11 位 8 Buy/3 Hold 均值 $502；MarketBeat 共識 $554.38；各聚合站數字不一（FN2 均值約 $443）
Morgan Stanley 2026-09-02 目標價調至 $575（Equal-Weight）；Baird 2026-08-21 以 Outperform、目標價 $550 啟動coverage
